blocks.rationale: Create the previously uninstalled airline calculator as a complete version-1 skill, but replace the repeatedly unresolved per-position base-fee fields with one current-case base-fee total. The procedure still performs the reusable item classification and per-bag overweight/oversize calculation. This directly targets all three airline trigger parents while leaving installed history skills unchanged.

skill.intent: Compute the exact integer ticket-plus-fees total for the current airline baggage case by assigning one personal item and one carry-on, adding the current checked-position base-fee total, and applying the higher applicable overweight or oversize charge to each checked bag.

outputs.description: The exact integer total of the current ticket price and every applicable baggage fee.
outputs.name: answer

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Use no more than one qualifying personal-item allowance and one qualifying carry-on allowance; treat every remaining current item as checked.

origin.quote:
1st and 2nd checked bags are complimentary for:
* AAdvantage Platinum® status
* oneworld® Sapphire members
* Confirmed Domestic First customers
* Confirmed Business customers
* Confirmed Premium Economy customers

source_obligations.statement: Sum the current route and cabin's checked-position fees after applying complimentary checked-bag allowances.

origin.quote: Main Plus includes 1 extra free checked bag in addition to the Main Cabin allowance (max of 2).

source_obligations.statement: When the current cabin is Main Plus, include its extra free checked bag subject to the stated maximum.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Calculate each checked bag's size by adding its outside length, width, and height.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When a checked bag exceeds both weight and size standards, add only the higher excess charge to the checked-position base fees.

source_provenance.quote: Your personal item like a purse or small handbag must fit under the seat in front of you. Dimensions should not exceed 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm).
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
For First / Business, weight is 70 lbs / 32 kgs for complimentary bags and 50 lbs / 23 kgs for excess charged bags
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
